sources.title: Pretraining LLMs - DeepLearning.AI
sources.snippet: Pretraining involves teaching an LLM to predict the next token using vast text datasets, resulting in a base model, and this base model requires further fine-tuning for optimal performance and safety. In this course, you'll learn to pretrain a model from scratch and also to take a model that's already been pretrained and continue the pretraining process on your own data.
